study: Post-earnings drift: after a confirmed good-news earnings report (EPS beat AND a positive reaction day), does a liquid stock keep outperforming over the next week, after market exposure and costs?
registered_at: 2026-10-06 ~19:15 ET, before any earnings event was collected or any outcome computed
origin: Operator 10/6: 'do we know the edge of certain names to be able to hold it across an entire week?' PRIOR RESULT DISCLOSED: the 9/27 LONGER_HOLDS study did run a news-flagged PEAD cell (gap >= 5% with an earnings flag, 5-day hold): net minus SPY -0.40%, t -3.5, out of sample 2022-26, an overlapping subset of H2. This test differs (any EPS beat with a positive reaction, beta-adjusted, same-name control) but the prior is LOW. Data check done before registering (format only, no outcomes): Finnhub's free earnings calendar has no history; Alpaca/Benzinga news carries structured headlines such as 'Apple Q3 EPS $2.18 Beats $2.1 Estimate' from at least 2019.
universe: US common stocks in the lh_cache panel (~/lh_cache/panel.npz, read via lh_core with the path fixed or symlinked) with raw close >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M where ADV20 is shifted by one day (20 sessions ending D0-1), point-in-time
period: reaction days 2019-01-02 .. 2026-09-18 (the panel ends 2026-09-25; the last D0 must leave 5 sessions; 2026-08-27 for the 20-session information hold); halves H1 2019-01-02..2022-12-30 and H2 2023-01-03..2026-09-18

events.source: Alpaca news API (Benzinga), fetched per symbol, cached; every request logged; abort the study if > 2% of symbols fail to fetch after retries. Articles are sorted by created_at locally (the API orders by update time). Renamed tickers: news is also fetched under prior tickers from Alpaca corporate-action name changes; symbols with < 2 events in an eligible year and all excluded counts are reported. Run after hours only (it shares the desk's API budget; ~30-100k requests).
events.headline_rule: the first headline per symbol per 10 calendar days, by created_at, matching r'\bQ[1-4]\b.*\bEPS\b' and an Estimate comparison; headlines starting 'CORRECTION' or 'UPDATE' are ignored, and headlines with Sees|Guidance|Outlook|Raises|Lowers before 'EPS' are excluded. SURPRISE = the first of Beats|Misses|In-Line|Inline that lies INSIDE the EPS clause (between 'EPS' and the first comma); if none is inside the EPS clause the event is 'unclassified' (counted, not traded). When several headlines arrive within 5 minutes with different EPS surprise words (e.g. Adj. vs GAAP), the one containing 'Adj.' wins; if none does, the event is unclassified.
events.reaction_day: timestamps converted from UTC to ET. D0 = the headline's session if before 09:30 ET; the next session if at or after 16:00 ET; the same session if during RTH; weekend/holiday headlines map to the next session
events.reaction: R0 = SIP 1-minute bar close at 15:45 ET on D0 / close(D0-1) - 1 (known before the MOC cutoff); the trade fills at close(D0). The auction close itself is NOT used for selection.

trade: buy at the close of D0 (after the reaction is known; an MOC order), sell at the close of D0 + 5 sessions

returns.beta_adjusted_excess: stock return over the hold minus beta x SPY return over the same hold; beta = OLS of daily stock on daily SPY returns over the 252 sessions ending D0 - 1 (min 150), point-in-time
returns.cost: 10 bp round trip (MOC in and out at ~2 bp/side plus slippage); 30 bp as a sensitivity

statistic: PRIMARY minus its matched control, net beta-adjusted 5-session excess (bp). SE (a) clustered by calendar week of D0 and (b) a calendar-time portfolio t: the daily mean excess of open PRIMARY-minus-control positions, Newey-West lag 5. Both are reported; the smaller |t| is used.
power: before reading means: SE per half; MDE = 2.84 x SE. UNDERPOWERED if MDE > 30 bp in either half. Accepted explicitly: a true +20 bp effect has roughly 50% power at that cutoff.
pass: PRIMARY minus control >= +20 bp (10 bp cost) with t >= 2 (the smaller of week-clustered and calendar-time NW) in BOTH halves, >= 300 events per half, still > 0 at 30 bp cost, and still > 0 after dropping the top 3 weeks and after dropping the top 5 names. Otherwise FAIL. A PASS (after skeptic review) earns a score-only pilot, not live money.
no_retuning: the headline rule, the 10-day dedupe, D0 timing, the 5-session hold, the beta window and the groups are fixed here; changes need a new pre-registration
prior: modest: PEAD is well documented historically but has weakened in large liquid stocks; the 9/27 gap+RVOL proxy failed; momentum beyond beta failed on 10/2
caveats: SURVIVORSHIP: the panel has inactive names ending 2018-2022 but only ~21 ending 2023-2026 (TWTR, SIVB, WWE, ATVI absent), so H2 is close to survivors-only; the same-name control is the main defence
Benzinga coverage ~89% of sampled quarters; misses ('May Not Compare', no estimate) are excluded and counted
control: per PRIMARY_GOOD event, one matched control: the same symbol, a random session (seed 41) within +/-60 sessions of D0 that is not within 10 sessions of any of that symbol's earnings events and whose 15:45 return vs the prior close is > 0; same entry (close), same 5-session hold, same point-in-time beta adjustment. This cancels name-level survivor drift.
information_only: EPS Misses AND R0 < 0 (the short side; reported, not traded)
excess vs SPY without beta adjustment
PRIMARY vs SPY without the control (the original statistic)
H1 with and without inactive names (sizes the survivorship bias)
amended: 2026-10-06, before any script or data, per the skeptic's FIX FIRST (B1, F1-F10, minors)
